title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Maya Patel
description: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: make it easier for engineers to get started with RAG + agents on Redwood by providing end-to-end, battle-tested examples and concise quickstarts that demonstrate patterns (prefix caching, safe tool invocation, result validation) used in production. Work included: 1) new quickstart folder with three opinionated guides (nodejs, python, and curl) showing how to wire Redwood API, a simple vector store adapter, and a basic reranker; 2) agent/tool-calling examples demonstrating tool schemas, structured tool responses, and function-calling patterns including retry/backoff and safety checks; 3) RAG templates: canonical prompt templates and evaluation harness snippets used by the docs and evals team; 4) docs site navigation updates: new sidebar entries, TOC pages, and cross-links from API reference to quickstarts; 5) small SDK sample updates (typescript & python) used by quickstarts. The description below summarizes the changes, testing, and rollout notes. Changeset summary: added /docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-quickstart (3 subfolders), added /examples/agents/tool-calling (node, python), updated docs/site/nav.yml and docs/site/quickstarts.md to include the new content, added prompt templates under /templates/rag and evaluation snippets under /eval-harness/examples/rag. Commits are atomic and focused: initial quickstart scaffolding, add node example, add python example, docs site wiring, tests & CI fixes, final copyedits. Testing: local smoke tests for quickstarts (scripts/verify_quickstarts.sh) run in CI step 'quickstarts:verify' and passed; examples include minimal unit tests for tool-calling handlers and an integration smoke test that runs a minimal RAG flow against a mocked vector store. Security & privacy: quickstarts use placeholder credentials and a mocked vector store; we added a short security note in docs explaining production KMS and PII handling. Linear refs included. Rollout: merged to main, will be monitored via docs analytics and example-run telemetry for the next week; if we see errors in the quickstart CI step we will revert or patch the offending example. Checklist: - [x] Quickstarts added (node, python, curl) - [x] Tool-calling examples implemented - [x] Docs site navigation updated - [x] CI tests added and green - [x] Security notes included - [x] Review approvals obtained (Carlos, Elena) Known limitations: the python example uses a simple in-memory vector store adapter and a note explains how to swap to a real managed vector DB. Follow-ups planned: ENG-2156.
